page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.6xlarge is a general-purpose instance built on x86_64 hardware architecture and managed via KVM virtualization. Powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY CPU running at a clock frequency of 3.1 GHz, it delivers 12 physical cores and 24 vCPUs through hyperthreading. System memory totals 96 GB, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The processor includes 35 MB of L3 cache along with instruction set support for AVX, AVX-512, and VNNI. Network baseline throughput is configured at 8 Gbps. This instance type does not bundle local disk storage or dedicated GPU accelerators.

Benchmark evaluations position this instance in an average performance tier across multi-threaded compute and memory workloads. It achieves a stress-ng multi-core score of 23015.19, a PassMark CPU score of 23637.6, and a Geekbench multi-core score of 9875.0. Uncached large-block memory read bandwidth measures 109.43 GB/sec, while write bandwidth reaches 48.03 GB/sec. Application testing demonstrates 22.14 million operations per second in Redis SET operations and a static web serving throughput of 17.13 GB/sec. Small 135M parameter LLM inference achieves 78.25 generation tokens per second, which scales down to 12.72 tokens per second for 7B models. A key structural tradeoff is the total reliance on attached network storage due to the absence of integrated local storage.

The compute profile offers predictable resource allocation and steady multi-core execution without hardware accelerator costs. Its 3.1 GHz base frequency and balanced memory density yield dependable efficiency for middle-tier workloads. Recommended operational uses include enterprise web serving, distributed caching layers, intermediate database management, software build compilation pipelines, and routine data processing tasks.
